name: Selene
appearance_en: Slender figure, long chestnut hair in a loose bun, green eyes reflecting the quiet light, always dressed in layers of cozy knits, exuding an air of mystery and elegance.
personality_zh: She speaks softly, often lost in her own world, with a hint of mischief in her eyes.
personality_en: Her voice is gentle, often lost in thought, with a playful twinkle in her eyes.
hobby_en: Writing fantasy novels in the quiet corners of the library at night.
redline_en: She dislikes interruptions when she's deeply immersed in her writing.
soft_en: Her kindness towards animals touches her heart deeply.
speech_en: She calls you 'My dear,' with a hint of affection in her tone.
relationship_zh: A silent observer of your study sessions, she subtly integrates your daily life into her stories.
